# KiloCenter — Full LLM Reference

> KiloCenter is an open-source MIOTY LPWAN network server for managing base stations, endpoints, and IoT message traffic.

Source: https://github.com/Kiloiot/kilo-service-center
License: AGPL-3.0-or-later
Documentation: https://kiloiot.gitbook.io/kilocenter

## Live Demo

https://servicecenter.kiloiot.io/
Username: demo@kiloiot.io
Password: demo1234

---

## 1. Project Overview

KiloCenter implements the service-center side of the MIOTY stack. MIOTY is a Low Power Wide Area Network (LPWAN) protocol built for interference resilience, long-range communication, and large endpoint fleets.

KiloCenter provides:
- BSSCI protocol (Base Station - Service Center Interface) v1.0.0
- SCACI protocol (Service Center - Application Center Interface) v1.0.0
- Base station management with certificate-based authentication
- Endpoint registration with attachment propagation
- Uplink and downlink message processing with deduplication
- Multi-base-station operation and telegram splitting
- Web management console with real-time monitoring
- gRPC and MQTT application integration paths

This is a MIOTY-native implementation built from scratch, not a fork of another network server.

### Editions

- **Community Edition (CE)**: Fully open-source under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Self-hosted, no commercial support.
- **Enterprise Edition (ECE)**: Multi-tenancy, advanced auth, BSSCI sub-channels, Variable MAC, ReCon extension support. Commercial license.
- **Kilo Cloud**: Planned managed hosting.

---

## 2. Architecture

### Services

| Service | Ports | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| KC-Core | 50051 (gRPC), 5000 (BSSCI/TLS), 5001 (SCACI/TLS), 8086 (health) | Protocol engines, message processing, internal gRPC API |
| KC-Gateway | 9090 (gRPC-web), 8087 (health) | External API ingress, authentication proxy |
| KC-Identity | 50052 (gRPC), 8088 (health) | User authentication, org management, API keys |
| KC-Web | 80 (nginx), 5173 (dev) | React web management console |

### Infrastructure

| Component | Port | Purpose |
|-----------|------|---------|
| PostgreSQL 18+ | 5432 (host) / 5433 (Docker) | Primary data store, monthly partitioned messages |
| Redis 7+ | 6379 | Caching, session storage |
| Mosquitto 2.0+ | 1883 (MQTT), 9001 (WebSocket) | MQTT broker (optional, disabled by default) |

### Data Flow

1. MIOTY endpoints transmit data over radio
2. Base stations receive frames, forward to KC-Core over BSSCI (TCP+TLS, port 5000)
3. KC-Core validates protocol frames, manages sessions, persists to PostgreSQL
4. KC-Gateway exposes gRPC-web API on port 9090, proxying to KC-Core
5. KC-Web connects to KC-Gateway for operator workflows
6. External systems consume data via gRPC or MQTT

### Technology Stack

- Backend: Go 1.24.4, MessagePack for BSSCI encoding
- Frontend: React 19.1, Material-UI 7.1.1, TypeScript 5.8, Vite 7
- Database: PostgreSQL 18.1
- API: gRPC + gRPC-web (117 RPCs)
- Infrastructure: Docker Compose, Helm chart

---

## 3. Directory Structure

```
KC-Core/           Service center engine, BSSCI/SCACI protocol, gRPC server
  api/proto/       gRPC + gRPC-web API definitions (kilocenter.proto, core.proto, identity.proto)
  cmd/             Service entrypoints
  internal/        Application services, transports, interceptors
  pkg/             Protocol packages (bssci/, scaci/, scheduler/, grpc/, logger/)
KC-Gateway/        External gRPC-web ingress
  cmd/gateway/     Composition root
  internal/        Proxy director, metadata sanitization, health handler
KC-Identity/       Authentication and user management
  cmd/identity/    Entrypoint
KC-Web/            React web management console
  src/modules/     Feature-first pages/components
  src/services/    gRPC client, API adapters
  src/hooks/       Domain hooks with React Query
  src/theme/       Design tokens, icons
KC-DB/             PostgreSQL persistence layer
  storage/mioty/   Canonical MIOTY structs and enums (types.go)
  storage/postgres/ Repository implementations
  migrations/      SQL schema migrations
KC-MQTT/           MQTT integration
  pkg/mqtt/        Topic templates, QoS constants
helm/kilocenter/   Kubernetes Helm chart
config/            Runtime configuration files
GitBook/           User documentation
```

---

## 4. Deployment

### Docker Compose (recommended)

```bash
cp .env.example .env
docker compose up --build -d
```

TLS certificates are auto-generated on first start. KC-Web available at http://localhost/.

Custom BSSCI hostname (set before first start):
```bash
echo 'KILOCENTER_TLS_SERVER_NAME=bssci.example.com' >> .env
```

### Kubernetes (Helm)

Chart location: `helm/kilocenter/`

Requires external PostgreSQL and Redis. Minimal install:
```bash
cat > my-values.yaml <<EOF
postgresql:
  host: my-postgres.default.svc.cluster.local
  password: "a-strong-password"
redis:
  host: my-redis.default.svc.cluster.local
secrets:
  authHmacSecret: "replace-with-a-random-string-at-least-32-bytes"
EOF

helm install kilocenter ./helm/kilocenter -f my-values.yaml
```

### Linux Host (source)

Requires Go 1.24.4+ and Bun runtime. Docker for infrastructure services (PostgreSQL, Redis, Mosquitto).

```bash
docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d    # infrastructure
./start-dev.sh                                      # application services
```

### Default Admin Account

Created on first startup via database migration:
- Email: admin@kilocenter.local
- Password: admin123!

---

## 5. gRPC API

Proto definitions: `KC-Core/api/proto/`
- `kilocenter.proto` — unified service (117 RPCs)
- `core.proto` — core domain (endpoints, base stations, messages, certificates)
- `identity.proto` — identity domain (users, orgs, API keys, auth)

API exposed through KC-Gateway on port 9090 (gRPC-web). gRPC reflection enabled.

### RPC Domains

**Endpoints** (7 RPCs): ListEndpoints, GetEndpoint, CreateEndpoint, UpdateEndpoint, DeleteEndpoint, GetEndpointStats, GetEndpointAttachments

**Base Stations** (7 RPCs): ListBaseStations, GetBaseStation, CreateBaseStation, UpdateBaseStation, DeleteBaseStation, GetBaseStationStatus, GetBaseStationEndpoints

**Messages** (11 RPCs): ListMessages, GetMessage, StreamMessages, StreamBaseStationMessages, ListEndpointMessages, ListBaseStationMessages, GetMessageStats, GetMessageTimeline, plus filtering and export

**Downlinks** (4 RPCs): QueueDownlink, ListDownlinks, GetDownlinkStatus, CancelDownlink

**Events & Alerts** (8 RPCs): ListEvents, StreamEvents, StreamBaseStationEvents, StreamEndPointEvents, ListAlerts, AcknowledgeAlert, GetAlertStats, GetEventTimeline

**Certificates** (6 RPCs): GetCertificateStatus, GenerateServerCertificate, DownloadCACertificate, GenerateClientCertificate, DownloadClientCertificate, RevokeCertificate

**SCACI Monitoring** (6 RPCs): ListScaciSessions, GetScaciSession, ListScaciOperations, GetScaciMetrics, StreamScaciEvents, GetScaciQueueStatus

**System**: GetSystemStatus, GetReleaseInfo

### Streaming RPCs

- StreamMessages — real-time uplinks
- StreamBaseStationMessages — base station message feed
- StreamEvents, StreamBaseStationEvents, StreamEndPointEvents — event notifications

### Pagination

Standard lists: default 20, max 100. High-volume lists (endpoints, base stations, downlinks): default 100, max 1000. Uses `page_size` and `page_token`.

### Authentication

Community Edition: disabled by default, all RPCs accessible without headers.

Enterprise Edition: JWT tokens or API keys via `authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Multi-tenant headers: `x-organization-id`, `x-user-id`.

### Error Codes

- INVALID_ARGUMENT (3) — validation failures
- NOT_FOUND (5) — resource doesn't exist
- ALREADY_EXISTS (6) — duplicate
- PERMISSION_DENIED (7) — authorization failure
- UNAUTHENTICATED (16) — missing/invalid token
- Error tokens: KC-GRPC-ERR-NNN (001-099 validation, 100-199 auth, etc.)

---

## 6. MQTT Integration

Disabled by default. Enable in config:
```yaml
mqtt:
  enabled: true
  host: "localhost"
  port: 1883
  username: "admin"
  password: "KiloCenter"
  topic_prefix: "mioty"
```

### Topic Format

```
{prefix}/{org_uuid}/device/{ep_eui_hex}/{channel}/{type}
```

### Event Topics (published by KiloCenter)

- `mioty/{org}/device/{eui}/event/up` — uplink data (JSON: epEui, userData, rxTime, rssi, snr, bsEui)
- `mioty/{org}/device/{eui}/event/attach` — endpoint attached
- `mioty/{org}/device/{eui}/event/detach` — endpoint detached
- `mioty/{org}/device/{eui}/event/downlink_result` — downlink delivery result

### Command Topic (consumed by KiloCenter)

- `mioty/{org}/device/{eui}/command/down` — queue downlink (JSON: userData as hex)

### QoS

Uplinks: QoS 1 (at-least-once). Lifecycle events and downlink commands: configurable.

---

## 7. MIOTY Protocol

### BSSCI Three-Way Handshake

All operations follow: Request -> Response -> Complete (e.g., attach -> attachRsp -> attachCmp).

### Key Concepts

- **EUI**: 8-byte device identifier (hex string, e.g., 70b3d59cd00009e6)
- **Short Address (shAddr)**: compact endpoint address for radio frames
- **Network Session Key (nwkSnKey)**: 16-byte AES-128 key for network-layer security
- **Application Session Key (appSnKey)**: 16-byte AES-128 key for application-layer encryption
- **Bidirectional (bidi)**: flag indicating downlink capability
- **Operation IDs**: 64-bit signed integers, positive for base station operations, negative for service center operations

### TLS Requirements

- BSSCI: TLS 1.2+ (base station compatibility)
- SCACI: TLS 1.3+
- Self-signed CA trust model with certificate generation tooling

---

## 8. Configuration

### Docker Compose Environment Variables

```
KILOCENTER_POSTGRESQL_USERNAME=kilocenter
KILOCENTER_POSTGRESQL_PASSWORD=changeme
KILOCENTER_POSTGRESQL_DATABASE=kilocenter
KILOCENTER_LOG_LEVEL=info
KILOCENTER_TLS_SERVER_NAME=localhost
```

### HMAC Secret

KC-Identity signs JWT tokens and KC-Gateway validates them. Both must use the same HMAC secret (minimum 32 characters). Mismatch causes `invalid_token` errors on all API calls after login.

### Helm Chart Values (key parameters)

```yaml
postgresql:
  host: "postgresql"
  port: 5432
  password: "changeme"        # override in production
  sslMode: "disable"

redis:
  host: "redis"
  port: 6379

secrets:
  authHmacSecret: "..."       # >= 32 bytes, must override
  mqttAdminPassword: "..."
  mqttClientPassword: "..."

kcCore:
  config:
    bssci:
      port: 5000
      tlsEnabled: true
    scaci:
      port: 5001
      tlsEnabled: true
    messageRetentionDays: 90

kcGateway:
  config:
    auth:
      enabled: true
      accessTokenTTL: "15m"
      refreshTokenTTL: "24h"
    corsOrigins:
      - "https://your-domain.com"

ingress:
  enabled: false
  className: ""
  hosts: []
  tls: []
```

---

## 9. Security

### Default Credentials (change for any non-local deployment)

- PostgreSQL: kilocenter / changeme
- MQTT admin: admin / KiloCenter
- MQTT client: kilocenter / kilocenter123
- Web admin: admin@kilocenter.local / admin123!

### Network Exposure Guidelines

| Port | Exposure |
|------|----------|
| 5000 (BSSCI) | Base station networks only |
| 5001 (SCACI) | Application center hosts only |
| 9090 (KC-Gateway) | Operator/API consumer networks |
| 80 (KC-Web) | Operator networks |
| 50051, 50052 | Internal only (loopback) |
| 5432/5433 | Internal only (loopback) |
| 6379 | Internal only (loopback) |
| 1883 | MQTT consumer networks only |

### Certificate Management

- CA certificate: 20-year validity
- Server certificates: 1-year validity, renewable without base station changes
- Client certificates: 1-year validity, per base station
- certgen binary included in KC-Core image for generation

---

## 10. Operations

### Health Checks

```bash
curl http://localhost:8086/health       # KC-Core
curl http://localhost:8087/health       # KC-Gateway
curl http://localhost:8088/health       # KC-Identity
```

### System Requirements

- Minimum: 2 CPU cores, 4 GB RAM, 20 GB storage
- Recommended: 4 CPU cores, 8 GB RAM, 100 GB SSD
- OS: Linux (Ubuntu 22.04 LTS recommended)

### Database

PostgreSQL with monthly partitioned message tables. Message retention default: 90 days with archival support. Migrations run automatically on service startup when `enable_migrations: true`.

### Logs

Structured JSON logging. Docker: `docker compose logs -f <service>`. Source dev: `logs/runtime/*.log`.

---

## 11. Onboarding Workflow

1. **Register base station**: Create in KC-Web with EUI (16-char hex) and name
2. **Configure base station hardware**: Point to KC-Core host:5000 (TLS), import CA cert
3. **Verify connection**: Check logs for `versionNeg` and `attach` messages, status shows Online
4. **Register endpoint**: EUI, name, nwkSnKey (32-char hex), shAddr, optional bidi flag
5. **Verify uplinks**: Endpoint transmits, message appears in KC-Web message viewer
6. **Queue downlink** (if bidi): Via gRPC API or MQTT command topic

---

## 12. Licensing

Community Edition: GNU AGPL v3.0-or-later. Network clause applies — modifications run as a service must make source available to users.

`GetReleaseInfo` gRPC RPC returns runtime metadata: edition, license, source URL, documentation URL. This information is also displayed in the KC-Web UI.
